moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Tesla will be winding down production of the Cybertruck at Gigafactory Texas around the middle of next year to make room for increased Cybercab production
moments.why: The end of the divisive Cybertruck marks a major shift in Tesla’s strategy toward autonomous vehicles.

moments.author: Cristiano Ronaldo
moments.quote: Today I finish my walk on the pitch with the national team… Portugal will always be in me. Forever.
moments.why: A legendary international career ends, sparking global football conversation.

moments.author: Joel Embiid
moments.quote: Retroactively assessed a Flagrant 1 for kicking Cade Cunningham — video just exploded online.
moments.why: An unusual and explosive act during an NBA game has become a viral flashpoint among basketball fans.

moments.author: Sky Sports News
moments.quote: BREAKING: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football
moments.why: Sky’s coverage of Ronaldo’s announcement sent the news through sports circles rapidly.
